title: Q-PARITY-1: Mail-path self-heal in the tick: clear bounce suppressions on owner addresses and record every mail send outcome
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/tick.js::unsuppress
**Status:** closed

Quniverse parity (owner directive 2026-11-13: Ultrastable audits and remediates all failure modes and ships improvements with zero user intervention; every Quniverse automation feature is incorporated).

The Cloudflare account's Email Sending list suppressed the owner's address after one soft bounce on 2026-11-12 and no sign-in code could be sent (QNFO OWNER-MAIL-UNSUPPRESS-1, PR QNFO/qnfo-workers#11396). Port it: dashboard/worker.js already tries OWNER_EMAIL then OWNER_EMAIL_BACKUP; add to seed/worker a tick step that lists /accounts/{id}/email/sending/suppressions and deletes entries for the owner bindings with reason soft_bounce or hard_bounce, never complaints, never other recipients. Test with an injected fetch.

size: S

**Closing probe:** grep:seed/worker/src/tick.js::unsuppress

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 203.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
